name: PageContainer
description: The layout root named by agents/page-generation.json. Renders <main> by default, so a generated page gets its main landmark without anyone remembering to add one.
intent: One max-width, one gutter, one place to change either.

props.name: width
props.hint: One of the width values declared in pageContainerVariants.

props.name: gutter
props.hint: One of the gutter values declared in pageContainerVariants.

props.name: spacing
props.hint: One of the spacing values declared in pageContainerVariants.

props.name: as
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

variants.name: prose
variants.when: max-w-2xl. Long-form reading, where line length matters.

variants.name: full
variants.when: No max-width. Keeps the gutter; drops the constraint.

notes: Renders <main>, which supplies the main landmark. Exactly one per page — set as="div" for any additional container.
The gutter never collapses below px-4, so content keeps a 16px side margin at every width, including gutter="none".
Vertical rhythm uses py-*, never a padding shorthand, so the side gutter cannot be zeroed by accident.

usage: The outermost wrapper of any generated page
Any region needing the standard horizontal rhythm
Satisfying the layout root in the page-generation contract
doNotUse: Nested inside another PageContainer — the gutters compound
Inside a ui:dialog or ui:sheet, which bring their own padding
For a full-bleed region; use width="full" on a child instead of dropping the container
Use inside a dialog or sheet

agentRules: One <main> per page. Additional containers use as="div".
Pick width from the content: prose for reading, wide for data.

related.note: SidebarInset owns the main region instead

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
No Guild semantic tokens declared in the manifest or extracted from TSX. Not guessed.
